request.purpose: Scientific research on medication use and treatment gaps in routine care.
request.question: How many adults with type 2 diabetes are not on metformin, by region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Metformin = ATC code starting with A10BA.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per region: adults with type 2 diabetes, how many of them have no active metformin and that share in %, one decimal.
